name: OpenClaw Operational Agent Platform
mechanism: Hosts persistent agents behind a gateway with sessions, channels, tools, skills, plugins, runtime selection and policy-aware operational configuration.
use_when: A persistent multi-channel personal or team agent host is the product boundary
Gateway, session, tool, skill and plugin operations need one managed control plane
avoid_when: The application only needs an embeddable model-tool loop
The team cannot operate and harden the larger gateway and plugin surface
expected_effects: Integrated operations for persistent channel-connected agents
Consistent session, skill, tool and plugin management
failure_modes: Gateway or channel binding crosses tenant or identity boundaries
Plugins expand authority or dependency risk without review
Frequent platform changes outpace configuration and rollback testing
